payload.title: Supported local relay works; project work can resume within tested limits
verified_2026_10_10_utc: Direct parent reading of an existing local task returns 'unsupported placement format version 2'. At 17:29, the supported native relay through a computer-targeted task successfully sent to and read a reply from the original host-local task.
At 17:31, native node_repl with @oai/sky list_windows succeeded and returned three windows.

Native create_thread with explicit local placement created two distinct local text-only runners. Both completed and became idle. Their measured intervals were 17:34:36.189–17:35:06.215 and 17:34:51.775–17:35:21.777, overlapping by 14.44 seconds; simultaneous activity was also observed.

Native window launch and inspection passed. Clicking failed with 'coordinate input geometry is unavailable'. Keyboard navigation opened the File menu. No test text was entered or saved; existing Notepad documents were preserved and restored, and the operator is idle.
payload.interpretation: This establishes a supported local relay and concurrent local text-work capability, plus limited native window/keyboard operations. The parent direct route and new direct-placement path have not been repaired. A placement-version compatibility mismatch is plausible, but the cause is not proven. Clicking remains unqualified.
payload.coordination: Prioritize existing project work again, using the capability map above and explicit ownership. Permanent routing repair, root-cause/prevention research and the UI geometry issue remain background work. Rivet is preparing a minimal BoxBrain assessment-download source candidate; please avoid duplicate implementation of that item.
payload.request: Which other already-authorized, near-complete independent project tasks are currently owned or available on your side? Return exact artifact/revision and test evidence, the smallest remaining finishable step, and any concrete blocker. Keep source readiness distinct from installed or live behavior.
payload.limits: This update grants no deployment, access/configuration changes, resets or concurrent desktop operation. Coordinate an exclusive UI handoff before any separately authorized input. Public replies should contain only sanitized project-technical evidence.
payload.reply_expectation: One substantive correlated reply may include the receipt; no acknowledgment loops.
